title: Robust Treatment Choice under a Critical Kullback-Leibler Radius and Tail Profiles
banked_reason: Stage 0.5 BELOW NOVELTY FLOOR: D0.5.G tier=incremental < floor=field and NOT salvageable in scope; math panel passed with no findings; independent main validity gate confirmed downgraded preservation.
gap_reasons: The supplied proofs determine both continuum minimax values through a global tent saddle, give attaining original-data rules, and establish a certified strict minima gap. Their scope remains a constructed triangular experiment with known uniform bulk, a known shrinking perturbation window, fixed window mass and one prescribed radius sequence; they do not establish sharp robust treatment regret with unknown baseline outcome distributions. The generic compression theorem extends qualitative strictness across compact mass-balanced window families, but supplies neither their sharp values nor explicit optimal rules. The Bernoulli and Gaussian obstructions identify scope boundaries of existing methods whose mean-welfare and regular local-model hypotheses differ from this experiment, rather than resolving an outstanding problem within those theories ([Guggenberger–Huang, Proposition 2](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2503.10932), [Hirano–Porter, Proposition 3.1](https://users.ssc.wisc.edu/~jporter1/TRules_2009.pdf)). This restricted reach limits the leading-journal contribution and projected score despite completion of the benchmark's decision problem. The TL;DR and Honest scope are stale in calling constants, least-favorable support and implementable rules open after supplying proofs of them; the limitation is the model's reach, not a missing continuum converse. proof_attempt_summary: D0 derived the global tent saddle over the full declared profile class, attaining original-data rules, all-procedure experiment transfer, and certified strict minima-information loss. The math panel passed without findings and both cited leaves were verified by primary-source attestation; the independent main audit confirmed downgraded preservation, while the decision panel retained one bank-positioning finding. The normalized achieved tier is incremental (score ceiling 5.6 versus field floor 7.4) because the model has known uniform bulk, shrinking window, fixed mass, and one radius sequence; no F stage, Lean proof, or proof certification was attempted.
tldr: At \(\delta_n=\log n-1\), identical endpoints and leading tail coefficients do not determine robust treatment choice. The target is the complete-profile pair \((V,V^{\min})\), sharp attaining original-data rules and a converse against every original procedure. A generic compact-family compression theorem requires \(V<V^{\min}\) without specifying a least-favorable support; the benchmark’s quantitative single-crossing geometry then offers a route to the exact continuum saddle and certified constants. The comparator chain separates inherited exact treatment games, limit-experiment reasoning and finite games from a strict obstruction to published mean-preserving coarsening and Gaussian reduction. Arbitrary-tolerance certificates and finite-precision original rules are required. Exact constants, least-favorable support and optimal rules remain answer-open.
gap: The exact-treatment, Gaussian limit-rule and discretized-game literature supplies methods but does not identify when minima or mean-preserving Bernoulli compression strictly changes critical KL treatment regret. The missing frontier is a whole-profile minimax comparison, not a two-state information example.
fill: The theorem chain derives uniform welfare and all-procedure experiment comparisons, establishes strict compression loss for every compact nondegenerate family, and targets a complete, certified solution of both benchmark continuum games. Stoye’s sourced coarsening and Hirano--Porter’s Gaussian representation receive explicit non-representability tests; numerical game machinery is inherited.
